body.name: Unique total private second-order local mechanism
body.construction: For \(n<2\), return zero. For \(n\ge2\) and vector cell features \(f,g\), set \(U_j(f,g)=0\) when \(N_j<2\), and otherwise set \(U_j(f,g)=\{N_j(N_j-1)\}^{-1}\sum_{i\ne i':X_i,X_{i'}\in C_j}f(O_i)^\top g(O_{i'})\). Select \((h,\ell)\) deterministically from the public parameters over a finite grid satisfying \(\ell\le h\) and \(n\ell^d\le c_0\), with a fixed tie-break. Form \(F_{lj}(O)=B_l(X)A\Phi_j(X)\), \(M_j(O)=Y\Phi_j(X)\), \(s_l^V=(nH)^{-1}\sum_i\mathbf 1\{X_i\in Q_h\}B_l(X_i)A_iY_i\), \(s_{lr}^W=(nH)^{-1}\sum_i\mathbf 1\{X_i\in Q_h\}B_l(X_i)B_r(X_i)A_i\), \(q_l^V=(kp_2)^{-1}\sum_jU_j(F_{lj},M_j)\), and \(q_{lr}^W=(kp_2)^{-1}\sum_jU_j(F_{lj},F_{rj})\). Arrange the raw coordinates in the exact order \(S_{h,\ell}=(s_1^V,\ldots,s_p^V;\operatorname{vech}_{l\le r}(s_{lr}^W);q_1^V,\ldots,q_p^V;\operatorname{vech}_{l\le r}(q_{lr}^W))\), release exactly once as \(\widetilde S_{h,\ell}=S_{h,\ell}+Z_{h,\ell}\), and add mutually independent \(\operatorname{Laplace}(\Delta_1(S_{h,\ell})/\epsilon_n)\) noise to all \(p^2+3p\) coordinates. Only \(l\le r\) Gram coordinates are released. Reconstruct \(\bar V_l=\widetilde s_l^V-\widetilde q_l^V\) and \(\bar W_{lr}=\bar W_{rl}=\widetilde s_{lr}^W-\widetilde q_{lr}^W\). With \(G_B=H^{-1}\int_{Q_h}BB^\top dx\), \(\lambda_-=(1/2)e_0(1-e_0)\lambda_{\min}(G_B)\), and \(\lambda_+=2\lambda_{\max}(G_B)\), let \(\widetilde W\) be the Frobenius projection of \(\bar W\) onto \(\{G:\lambda_-I_p\preceq G\preceq\lambda_+I_p\}\), equivalently eigenvalue clipping. Return uniquely \(T_{\mathrm{priv}}(h,\ell)=\operatorname{clip}_{[-2,2]}(e_1^\top\widetilde W^{-1}\bar V)\). Counts, symmetric duplication, spectral projection, inversion, intercept extraction, final clipping, and the deterministic bandwidth choice are unreleased postprocessing.
